title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: Sightsavers Irelands' Citizenship and Political Participation Programme is implemented in 8 of Cameroon’s 10 regions, aiming to reach women, men and youth with disabilities. Key partners include various government ministries and non-governmental organisations. The target is for 10 councils to develop inclusive local development plans and to train 368 people with disabilities. Key activities include strengthening the disability movement in gender, inclusion, citizenship, and the local electoral process; enhancing the meaningful participation and representation of people with disabilities in governance systems and processes; and advocating for inclusive and accessible local governance and development. The overall aim of the project is to ensure that people with disabilities are included and able to participate in elections and political processes. In addition, the project aims to engage equal numbers of male and female participants.
